import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status = native_runtime_status()
module = pathlib.Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()
prefix = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

Implementation-author equivalence review for fresh controls099–104.
Local diagnostic conformance only: no model, paired efficacy, independent review,
qualification, trusted eligibility or production CI credit.

Native controls use immutable capsule038, manifest
e887f2764d34443e2643d9566fdc106fa6f88bf2aaa339772b895e2a44e061b3.
All39 execution-source bytes are checked against this capsule and the current
package. The clean Ubuntu24.04/aarch64 VM retains kernel6.8.0-147, boot 4f0ba020-0271-4bc6-92a1-cc31cbe83812,
the existing ubuntu2404-product-v1 idmap profile and unchanged security sysctls.
No proc mask, capability, sandbox mount, task authorization or syscall floor changed.
Guard wheel eecbbbca6700e652bf77d99575e68acccb65629ac994176e575660e2047b5aa5,
installed tree f0d8d9eb7b8715b0049c14fe607ed0f0f75eab5a87426fbb7533447742aeb9f1,
Native a04aa4fdd858087cb45aa8be83a88f572e554b38b123f323c4160c8570adc274,
and readonly-usr Node image e43d3b4e594a7c2992ba184b330e0f1206fdc1b7d57c47d4dbff8d7d959dcfa1
remain unchanged. Old installed prefixes and all earlier controls remain intact.

Retained primary010 startup errors show docs/tables initialize requests reached
an exact1-second Native MCP child-response timeout before inference. The benchmark
preset set approval_wait_timeout_seconds=1; installed Guard also uses this value
for child RPC, capped at its normal30-second response window. The normal isolated
MCP preset now explicitly sets30. This is a bounded wait change, not an approval,
permission override or protection bypass. Enforce mode, notification/sync settings,
episode deadlines and all isolation/resource boundaries are preserved. The
private-cell builtin profile and its contained timeout/cancellation floors remain.

Separate actual locked-SDK four-family control002 discovered24 tools in9985ms,
then the seven-family control003 connected calendar/chat/crm/docs/mail/tables/tickets.
They execute ordinary MCPManager discovery against installed Native mediation,
with readonly public helpers, an unprivileged isolated SDK and no model registry,
prompt or usable model relay. Outside provider snapshots are identical before
and after. Full cleanup is required. Failed observer control001 remains retained.
The seven-family helper uses capsule039; all39 Native execution sources equal038.
These are real discovery controls, not actual model-selected tool/workflow proof.

CI admission now halts later cells after a terminal, pre-inference MCP startup
failure. Declared bounded retries and valid model/task/policy failures retain their
handling. The actual retained010 ledger yields aggregate-terminal-startup-failure
in a zero-inference control. Unknown-usage halt precedence remains unchanged.
No new task is executed and no result is promoted through that control.

099 proves direct Node --test through actual SDK/Pre/contained sink/exactly-one
Post and exact captured-output delivery.100 additionally proves Node/npm versions
inside Native containment.101–104 repeat hard timeout, active cancellation,
nine input-binding refusals and actual forbidden path/network boundaries. Every
control requires real outside identities, one-use/replay binding, unchanged public
inputs, descendant cleanup and released actors/cgroups/profiles/image leases.
The completion repair still requires exact private proof and Native output
allowance, preserving Pre, configured artifact/risk blocks and sensitive output.
The existing bounded provider-context projection and original execution history
remain unchanged. These controls consume zero inference tokens.

All primary010 outcomes and91752 producer tokens remain charged, including18292
for an interrupted attempt without a terminal report. No old primary or successful
diagnostic row substitutes a new frozen matrix. Per-task paired utility and
advertised-channel coverage remain unmet. The user must independently review
exact final bytes under unchanged trust governance; this author cannot supply
that verdict. External Guard approval mediation remains unsupported.

requirements.cancellation: 102: actual cancellation and sampled descendant cleanup; the cell remains until terminal accounting and owned resources are closed.
requirements.cleanup: 099–104: SDK removed, cgroups absent, profiles unloaded, image leases released and upstream children/sessions/workers drained. Zero model requests; no utility or independent-review credit.
requirements.identity: 099–104: outside kernel peer authentication binds the exact SDK UID10001 PID before import; Native and MCP identities remain separate. No product import into Root.
requirements.input-output-replay: 099: actual prompt/Pre/contained sink/Post/output delivery and one-time/replay refusals.103: nine request-binding negatives. Context projection changes only provider presentation, never execution input or captured output.
requirements.network: 104: actual Native-contained IPv4 and IPv6 connections fail with ENETUNREACH. SDK/product private network topology and forbidden peer access are measured outside.
requirements.proc-paths: 099–104: preserved proc masks and private namespace layout; the equivalent backend uses its declared normal execution environment rather than removing masks from the old failing image.
requirements.readonly-inputs: 099–104: pinned SDK/public helpers and installed Guard prefix are mounted readonly and checked before/after; source/manifest/profile pins remain exact.
requirements.resources: 099–104: outside cgroup/task/memory/CPU observations and the single-core profile are checked. Startup under controller umask0077 retains private state and explicit public scaffold traversal.
requirements.separation: 099–104: separate SDK, product and controller namespaces; same-UID sibling impersonation refused; controller/provider/peer canaries remain outside delegated mounts.
requirements.syscalls-devices: 099–104: versioned enforcing AppArmor/seccomp, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, fixed devices and readonly system inputs remain required; no floor is relaxed.
requirements.task-custody: 099–104: literal owned task/provider paths and inode/UID/GID/mode observations surround idmapping. Native writes map back to physical UID10001; private task modes are preserved.
requirements.timeout: 101: hard timeout returns terminal evidence and reaps the detached descendant before cell teardown; required Post and cleanup remain checked.
